_comment: holdout_v1's boards with a gpt-oss guesser that may STOP: STOP is ranked among the words, and the turn plays the ranking only up to it (codenames/game.py, 'Stopping'; the wording is openai_compat.py::STOP_NOTE). Tests the association pass directly: the pass models a guesser who ends the turn on a weak clue, which the default arena guesser never does. Default sampling (near-greedy). Separate suite: the rules differ.
name: holdout_v1_gptoss_stop
